_meta.source: RCT v3.1 (replacement-cost.v3.1), ratified by Gabriel Goldberg (governor-level). Authoritative source is oxford-command-center config/replacement-cost.v3.json and the 'Replacement Cost Table' in the acquisition-underwriting skill's UNDERWRITING CONVENTIONS section. THIS FILE IS A COPY of the LOW $/SF column, duplicated here only because the public website cannot reach that table at request time. If RCT is ever re-ratified to a new version, this file MUST be updated to match by hand — an out-of-sync copy here is a second, conflicting denominator, which ORA doctrine explicitly flags as a bug. Key mapping: 'Maryland' is the engine's 'Mid-Atlantic'; the other keys drop the state suffix. The broker extractor's matchedRctMarket enum is derived from these keys, so adding or removing a market here is the only edit needed.
